rerun.detail: Its scripts ship in this folder, but run.mjs imports a copy of the engine build as the run used it (engine 0.0.1), which is not in this tree, and it reads the public BPI Challenge 2019 event log (728 MB, 4TU.ResearchData, doi 10.4121/uuid:d06aff4b-79f0-45e6-8ec8-e19730c248f1), which is not redistributed here. The 97 MB per-case file is not shipped for its size, so the audit counts re-tally only from results/audit-labels.json and results/summary-blind.json.
